sources.title: Natural Earth retained natural lake references for Caucasus and Nordic regions

access_metadata.source_date: 2022 release; observations composite, not a dated survey
access_metadata.geometry: Source River and Lake Centerline; Lake and Alkaline Lake polygons. Reservoir polygons excluded.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern generalised reference. River axes through regulated reaches are not reconstructed 1900 channels. Natural lake levels, deltas and banks may differ.

access_metadata.source_epoch: Continuously updated modern cartographic reference; individual feature dates retained in sourceFGDB
access_metadata.attribution: © Kartverket, N250 Kartdata, CC BY4.0. Modified sea reference for WWO.
access_metadata.use: Only actual Havflate intersecting retained NE physical land; no inferred water or historical claim. Island holes preserved.

sources.title: Iceland IS50V Vatnafar, selected pre-existing natural lake references

access_metadata.scale: 1:50000 cartographic water polygons, individual source dates retained
access_metadata.categories: yfirbordsvatn3=lake/pond; ahrifmanna3=artificial excluded. No glacier or river polygon mistaken for lake.
access_metadata.attribution: © Náttúrufræðistofnun / Landmælingar Íslands, IS50V Vatnafar, CC BY4.0. Modified for WWO.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern outlines of selected pre-existing lakes only, not surveyed1900 shores; glacier-retreat lakes are not added wholesale.
